I bought the VEVOR Yoga Stand Frame as a Christmas gift for my 7-year-old daughter and it has been such a great purchase! I was a little hesitant to assemble it myself because I knew it was going to be pretty tall, so my 6’2” son helped put it together for me. He said the instructions were fairly easy to follow as long as you take your time and read everything carefully. Once assembled, the finished product fit perfectly in my daughter’s bedroom and feels very sturdy and secure. My daughter is absolutely obsessed with it and uses it all the time. I also love that I’ve been able to rearrange her room a few different times without needing to completely take it apart, which made moving it around much easier than expected. The quality has been excellent and honestly even I use it sometimes! Overall, we are so happy with this product and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and durable addition to a child’s room or play space.
